event.text: I can read the external reference now.
Granted temporary read and write access to /reference. Changes there follow the workspace write capability.
I can also change it while workspace writing is granted.
Granted temporary read and execute access to /tools. Execution there follows the shell capability.
I can run what is in the tools directory now.
Granted temporary read, write, and execute access to /build. Changes there follow the workspace write capability. Execution there follows the shell capability.
I can build in place and run what comes out of it.
Revoked temporary path access to /build. Revoked temporary path access to /tools.
I will use the reference alone from here.
I will no longer use it.
